known.note: A XAML transform or opacity transition blocks the handoff, so hover, WithAnimation, an enter or exit, keyframes or a layout animation throws, and later updates keep throwing.
A declared .Opacity() change overrides a looping keyframe entry on opacity, which the model says holds the channel.
A one-shot keyframe entry added while .Opacity() declares 0.8 finishes at its last value, 1, which overrides the declared opacity until it next changes.
A .Set facade Scale write mixed with modifiers or features: the setter re-runs and clobbers the declared value or is migrated by the handoff, and throws once the visual is taken.
A facade Translation drag mixed with .Translation(): on main the last writer wins, and writing or resetting the declared translation zeroes the drag.
A facade Translation drag on an element without .Translation(): a handoff migrates or enables translation and the drag is lost (spec 066 §4.3 rule 1).
